card.name: Inside split capitalized and medical words
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long words broken up by the tokenizer, mostly in all-caps label headings or brand names such as FLAVORED, ADOLESCENTS and STROKE. Also seen in lowercase pieces such as pneumonitis.

modes.label: All-caps heading or brand pieces

modes.label: Lowercase mid-word pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of a lowercase medical or ordinary word.

card.plain: It fires partway through long words that are split into pieces, especially capitalized label headings and brand names.
